signal_description: OSCAR; 83 Samples Verzögerung; auf Rohsample-Zeitachse ausgerichtet; g.Pype non-commercial use

processing.alignment: sample_index is the original raw sample index; verified by all auxiliary channels

quality_rule.policy: retain entire trial only if task cue is at or after cutoff; original indices unchanged

ME_HandSide.reason: Not all contrast classes remain after exclusions.

ME_FootSide.reason: At least two classes and two independent blocks are required.

ME_FourClass.reason: Not all contrast classes remain after exclusions.

method: Fixed ridge penalty=10, training-fold standardization; leave-one-block-out; 3s epochs; 199 label permutations within blocks (legacy task/rest: within trial pairs). Exploratory, no multiplicity correction.
